Also, in order to limit how many event cards can possibly be on your screen at one, since having a ton will slow down the app, we can take advantage of the distance filter. 

I imagine local to a person there won’t be hundreds of events as there would be if they could set unlimited distance.  The default distance filter right now is up to 25 miles away and it can be pushed up to 60, but I think we should reduce even that to 50 or lower.
I’m going to remove dropshadows from unnecessary use cases like texts.

FYI: images, dropshadows, and gradients are computationally expensive, meaning they take up quite a bit of memory and dont do too well at letting go of it. Let’s keep this in mind as we continue designing this and other apps.
